title: Cambridge_data
description: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) dataset named Cambridge_data, deposited on OpenNeuro (ds007714) by Gemma Bale and colleagues and mirrored on NEMAR. The data are organized in BIDS format as SNIRF recordings with accompanying JSON and TSV metadata files (65 files, about 1.24 GB). The source deposit does not document the experimental paradigm, participant characteristics, or recording setup, so these details should be obtained from the original authors.
